speaker: Damián
cn: （不可置信）怪不得Luis不想来，这也太吓人了。
en: (Impossible!) No wonder Luis doesn't want to come—she's just too terrifying!

speaker: Damián
en: What can I do? Luis ordered me to.

speaker: Damián
cn: （假笑）Yolanda，这是我们的合同，你看看，如果哪里不明确我再解释给你听。
en: (fake smile) Yolanda, here’s the contract. Take a look. If you have any questions, I’ll walk you through it.

speaker: Yolanda
cn: （笑）先不急着签合同，（把下药的酒杯推给Damián）先喝口水吧，喝了我就签字。
en: (laughs) No rush on the contract. (slides the spiked drink toward Damián) Have a drink. Finish it, and I’ll sign.

speaker: Damián
en: You'll sign once I finish this?

speaker: Yolanda
en: (laughs) Drink up, and I'll sign it.

speaker: Damián(VO)
cn: 总感觉人的目的不单纯啊。算了，喂了合同，喝就喝吧！Samanta，之后你可要给我发奖金啊！
en: I’ve got a feeling she’s up to something. Whatever. If this is what it takes to land the deal, I’ll drink it. Samanta, you’d better give me a bonus after this!

speaker: Damián
en: (Happy) If there’s nothing else, I’ll get going—

speaker: Yolanda
cn: （皱眉）Isadora？你怎么来了？正好，这个小帅哥我喜欢，我直接带走了。
en: (frowning) Isadora? What are you doing here? Perfect timing. I like this handsome guy, so I’m taking him with me.

speaker: Isadora
cn: （冷声）Yolanda Méndez，我Isadora的男人，你还敢碰？
en: (coldly) Yolanda Méndez, he’s my man. You dare lay a hand on him?

speaker: Yolanda
cn: （惊）这是你男人？真是对不起，我也不知道啊！
en: (startled) This is your man? I'm truly sorry! I had no clue!

speaker: Yolanda
cn: （赔笑）我就下了点安眠药。合同我已经签好了，没什么事我就先走了。
en: (smiling faintly) I gave him some sleeping pills. The contract is signed. Everything done, I'll be leaving now.

speaker: Isadora
en: (angry) You're lucky that you got away!

speaker: Isadora
cn: （宠溺）值得吗？为了一单破生意差点出卖色相。
en: (affectionately) Was it really worth it? You almost sold yourself for one lousy deal.

speaker: Isadora
cn: （咋舌）这人怎么比之前重多了？长肌肉了？
en: (Stunned) Why is he so much heavier than before? Did he gain muscle or something?
